comments.author: @NeQ17
comments.text:
I spent part of my childhood in Malta in the late 60's and early 70's, it has and always will be in my heart,  It has changed so much now especially in Sliema and St Julian's where we lived, our house has been knocked down and replaced by a four story building, the street names have been changed from English to Maltese, which is only right. I loved to ride the old buses with seats built like a rock and the little alters and rosary beads dangling from the mirrors in front of the drivers.  
I have been back a few times, I am sad to see a lot of changes especially all the high rise hotels squashed into any tiny space they can fit into.  
The Maltese people are wonderful, their island is wonderful, I just hope it will always stay that way.
